articles.title: The Field That Never Filled
articles.summary: A farm buys more fertilizer each year; the hillside wheat still weakens while the pond below turns green enough to hide its water.
articles.summaryZh: 农场年年买更多肥料，坡上麦田仍越来越瘦，而坡下池塘却绿得看不见水面。
storyParagraphs: Wheat ears at Stone Slope Farm shortened for three years. Owner Gu Rong bought more fertilizer each season and spread it all before spring planting, certain that anything missing from the soil could simply be added. Across the farm, cattle manure stood uncovered beside a ditch, most straw was burned after harvest, and carts of grain and milk continually left the gate. The extra fertiliser briefly greened the field and protected a bank payment, so increasing the dose looked more reliable than changing the whole farm routine.

After a storm, algae covered the pond below the slope while wheat at the top remained yellow. Gu pointed to the total ledger: more nutrients entered than the harvest removed. The agronomist first followed the rain rather than the sum. Fertilizer washed away before crops needed it, manure leached into the ditch, topsoil eroded from the slope, and some material left soil and manure as gas. The algae forced the farm to buy clean stock water, turning an off-field loss into an immediate operating cost.

She also sampled different parts of the fields. Some elements accumulated excessively at the foot of the slope while the crest was depleted. Other nutrients remained in the soil but in forms or seasons unavailable to wheat roots. A surplus across the whole farm did not mean every field and growth stage could obtain what it needed. They drew nitrogen and phosphorus flows separately for a full season, recording purchased feed and fertiliser, harvested grain and milk, stored manure, soil change, runoff, erosion, and estimated gaseous loss.
Gu pushed away the invoice for another large spring dose and spent the money on testing, covered storage, and split application.

The slower plan cost him an early-yield bonus, and he left one strip untreated as a comparison. Results showed that placement and timing raised uptake while lowering runoff; the budget was updated by field rather than farm total. Monthly budgets now compared inputs, harvested exports, soil tests, and estimated losses, while uncertainty was written as a range rather than hidden inside one balance.

The farm began storing manure properly, composting it, and returning it according to soil results. More straw stayed on the land or found another use. Fertilizer was split across periods of actual crop demand, while cover crops and buffer strips protected the slope and kept the pond from receiving every excess. Nutrients leaving in products still required replacement, but inputs now had timing and destination. Legume cover, manure composting, and mineral supplements were credited only for nutrients made available at relevant times, not for material merely present on the farm.
The following spring, the first manure cart did not take its usual road toward the ditch. Standing at the junction, Gu waved a flag and sent it uphill to the poorest field.
storyParagraphsZh: 石坡农场连续三年麦穗变短。主人顾荣每年都多买肥料，春播前一次撒完，认定地里缺什么就补什么。农场另一边，牛粪堆在露天沟旁，收后的麦秸大半烧掉，卖出的谷物和牛奶则一车车离开。加肥曾短暂让麦苗返绿，也保住一笔银行还款，因此继续加量比改变整套农事看起来更可靠。
一场暴雨过后，坡下池塘浮满绿藻，坡顶麦苗却仍发黄。顾荣拿着总账说，买进来的养分明明比收成带走的更多。农艺师没有先看总数，而是沿着雨水走了一遍：肥料在作物需要前被冲走，粪堆渗入沟渠，表土从坡面流失，另有一部分从土壤和粪中变成气体离开。绿藻迫使农场另买洁净饮水，田外损失立刻变成经营成本。
她又在田间分区取土。坡脚某些元素积得过多，坡顶却已经耗竭；有些养分虽然仍在土里，所处形态和时节却不能被麦根利用。整个农场看似有余，并不代表每块地、每个生长阶段都拿得到。众人按整季分别画氮、磷流向，记录外购饲料与肥料、谷物和牛奶、粪肥库存、土壤变化、径流、侵蚀及估算气态损失。
顾荣推开再买一批春肥的账单，把钱投给检测、遮盖储粪与分次施用。
这套慢办法让他失去早产奖金，他还留下一条不处理的对照带。结果显示位置和时机提高吸收、减少径流；预算此后按地块更新，不再只看全场总数。月度预算同时比较投入、收获输出、土检与估算损失；不确定性写成范围，不再藏进一个总差额。
农场开始把粪肥妥善储存、堆制后按检测结果还田，麦秸更多留地或再利用。肥料分次施在作物真正需要的时期，坡地加了覆盖作物和缓冲带，池塘边不再成为多余养分的终点。卖出产品带走的部分仍需补充，但投入有了时间和去处。豆科覆盖、粪肥堆制与矿质补充，只有在相关时段真正可利用才计入，不能因材料留在农场就视为已供作物。
第二年春天，第一辆粪肥车没有照旧驶向沟边。顾荣站在岔路口挥旗，让车转上了最瘦的那片坡地。
explanationParagraphs: Nutrient cycling describes the movement, transformation, storage, reuse, and loss of essential elements among soil, organisms, products, water, and air. Totals for inputs and harvest removal are only a starting point. Chemical form, microbial processes, timing, location, erosion, drainage, and gaseous loss determine availability and environmental effects. A whole-farm balance can hide local depletion or excessive accumulation.
explanationParagraphsZh: 养分循环描述必需元素在土壤、生物、产品、水和空气之间的移动、转化、储存、再利用与损失。投入与收成总量只是起点；化学形态、微生物过程、时间、位置、侵蚀、排水和气态损失决定作物能否利用及环境后果。农场整体平衡可能掩盖局部耗竭或过度累积。

articles.title: The Orchard That Allowed No Insect
articles.titleZh: 一只虫也不能有的果园
articles.summary: An orchard owner sprays after finding the first damaged leaf; the insects vanish briefly, then return in crowds after their natural enemies are gone.
articles.summaryZh: 果园主发现第一片虫叶便反复喷药，虫子短暂消失后，却在失去天敌的树上成群回来。
storyParagraphs: Pear grower Zhou Yan painted 'not one insect' on his storehouse door. At the first curled leaf in spring, he ordered the whole orchard sprayed, then repeated the treatment every seven days without asking how many insects were present or which species they were. He wanted flawless fruit for the city's highest purchasing grade. The first spotless harvest won the premium and paid for a new sprayer, reinforcing the rule before its wider effects appeared.

After the first two sprays, leaf-rollers declined, but ladybirds and parasitoid wasps disappeared too. Weeks later, a different sap-feeding pest surged and the original chemical worked less well against it. Zhou increased applications. Bees became scarce among flowering trees, workers avoided recently treated rows, and costs doubled before fruit quality improved. Dead beneficial insects left fewer checks on secondary pests, and repeated exposure selected survivors less affected by the same product.

The buyer threatened to downgrade any crate with visible blemishes. Zhou read the warning, cancelled the next contracted spray, and put its cost into scouting. Two rows lost the top grade. Workers used protective intervals and approved labels; uncertainty was referred to local specialists rather than guessed from the story. Scouts marked sample routes before entering the orchard so they would not choose only damaged or convenient trees. Thresholds considered crop stage, expected injury, control cost, and uncertainty.

Each morning the crop-protection specialist clipped a few dozen leaves along a marked route and laid them in separate trays by tree row. She opened curled leaves, finding many empty and only a few with feeding larvae, then counted predators on the undersides. Workers cleared overwintering debris, reset traps, and protected beneficial insects. A red line on the tally sheet marked when expected damage would exceed the cost of action; only after a count crossed it did she unlock a targeted approved product and follow its label.

Zhou still disliked the insects left on the leaves. At harvest he weighed the saleable crates from the monitored rows against an untreated reference row, then placed the spray invoices beside them. More pears reached market although fewer applications had been made. One treatment had failed early, so the crew recorded its weather and result and changed the next permitted mode of action instead of repeating it by habit. Zhou crossed out the calendar dates that had once ordered spraying and kept the stained leaf trays beside the harvest ledger.
The next spring, Zhou found three aphids beneath a young leaf. He raised a hand to call the spray cart, saw a ladybird approaching beside them, and instead drew three dots on the monitoring board.
storyParagraphsZh: 梨园主周岩把‘一只虫也不能有’写在仓房门上。春天看到第一片卷叶，他便让工人整园喷药，此后每七天一次，不问虫有多少，也不问是哪一种。他要的是果面无瑕，好赶上城里最高等级的收购价。第一季无斑果拿到最高价，还买回一台新喷雾机；更广影响出现以前，这条规则先得到了奖励。
头两次喷药后，卷叶虫少了，瓢虫和寄生蜂也不见了。几周后，另一种吸汁小虫突然增多，原先药剂对它越来越不灵。周岩加大次数，开花树旁的蜂群却减少，工人也不愿在刚喷完的园里久留。果面没有更好，费用先翻了一倍。天敌减少后，次生害虫失去制约；反复使用同一药剂，也让较不敏感的幸存者留下更多后代。
收购商威胁：有可见斑点便降级。周岩看完通知，取消下一次约定喷洒，把那笔钱改作监测；两排梨因此被降级。工人遵守安全间隔与批准标签，不确定之处交给本地专业人员判断。监测员入园前先定抽样路线，避免只挑受害或方便的树；界线同时考虑作物阶段、预计损失、防治成本与不确定性。
每天清晨，植保员沿画好的路线摘几十片叶，按树行分放在浅盘里。她掰开卷叶，许多里面已经空了，只有少数仍有幼虫；翻到背面，还能数见捕食虫。工人清走越冬病残枝，重挂诱捕器，留下有益昆虫。计数表上有一道红线，预计虫伤超过处理成本才算越界；数字真正越过时，她才打开一种较有针对性的合规药剂，并照标签使用。
周岩仍不习惯叶上留着小虫。收获时，他把监测行与一行未处理参照梨分别过秤，又把喷药账单压在秤边。施药次数少了，可售梨反而更多。有一种药早早失效，工人便记下当日天气与结果，下一次改用获准的其他作用方式，没有照习惯重复。周岩划掉过去按日历喷药的日期，把沾着叶汁的浅盘留在收获账本旁。
第二年春天，周岩又在嫩叶背面看见三只蚜虫。他举起手想叫喷药车，看到旁边一只瓢虫正在爬近，便只在记录板上画了三个点。
explanationParagraphs: Integrated pest management begins with prevention, correct identification, and monitoring before deciding whether action is needed. It then combines cultural, biological, physical, genetic, and when necessary chemical methods according to crop-specific risk thresholds. Its aim is acceptable loss and lower overall risk, not eradication of all organisms. Products and thresholds must fit the pest, place, and time and follow approved labels and qualified local guidance.
explanationParagraphsZh: 综合虫害管理先通过预防、正确鉴定和监测判断是否需要行动，再依据作物与风险阈值组合栽培、生物、物理、遗传和必要的化学方法。它追求可接受损失与较低综合风险，而非消灭所有生物。药剂选择和阈值必须针对地点、时期与害虫，并遵守获准标签和本地专业指导。

articles.title: The Hen That Laid Three Hundred Eggs
articles.summary: A breeder keeps only the highest-laying hens as parents; the number in his ledger rises each year while the flock becomes less able to withstand heat.
articles.summaryZh: 养鸡人连续多年只留下产蛋最多的母鸡作亲本，账本上的数字越来越高，鸡舍也越来越经不起炎热。
storyParagraphs: Each year, poultry breeder Lu Chuan kept only the highest-laying hens and males from the same champion family as parents. After eight years, he had birds approaching three hundred eggs a year and buyers competed for them. Egg count appeared on the house sign; shell quality, longevity, and performance in summer heat did not enter the breeding ledger. The contract rewarded egg count alone, and each annual gain financed expansion, making omitted traits easy to treat as someone else's future problem.

The ninth year brought a prolonged heatwave. High-producing hens ate less, thin-shelled eggs increased, and many birds soon stopped laying. Similar leg problems appeared within the family. A neighbouring flock with lower production and more varied origins suffered the same heat but recovered much faster. Lu wanted another generation of maximum layers and found that nearly every available parent was closely related. The veterinary bill and lost production erased two years of premium income, making the hidden trade-off financially visible.

A veterinarian and breeder reviewed the records. Selecting one heritable trait also changed correlated traits and combinations of genes. A champion in one environment might not remain one under heat, different feed, or disease pressure. Concentrating parentage allowed hidden defects to meet more often and reduced variation available for future change. Records separated genetic relationships from feed, heat, age, and housing effects. A trait had to be heritable enough for selection, yet measured performance still belonged to an environment.

Lu pushed the champion-line order back across the desk, cancelled a high-volume egg contract, and brought unrelated birds into several breeding groups. Output would recover more slowly. Mating records limited close relatives, while frozen material and live lines preserved options that no current index valued. A selection index combined traits with stated weights, while genomic and pedigree information helped manage relatedness without replacing observed health and welfare.

The new objective recorded production alongside shells, health, reproduction, behaviour, and heat tolerance, with trials on different farms. Lu introduced unrelated families, preserved population diversity, and stopped allowing one champion male to father a whole generation. Progress slowed, but its costs were no longer hidden in other traits or the next extreme season. Selection weights were published before results were known, preventing a single good season from quietly redefining the breeding goal. Progress reports showed gain and loss for every trait, not only the one printed on the shed door.

At autumn selection, the highest-laying hen still occupied the first pen. Lu passed her and placed the parent leg band on the second bird, whose legs and shells remained sound and whose laying had continued through summer.
storyParagraphsZh: 养鸡人陆川每年只留产蛋最多的母鸡和同一冠军家系的公鸡作亲本。八年后，他养出一批一年能下近三百枚蛋的鸡，收购商争着上门。蛋数写在鸡舍门牌上，蛋壳、寿命和炎夏里的表现却没有进入那本选种账。合同只按蛋数付款，每年增长又能扩建鸡舍，于是被遗漏的性状很容易被当成未来才需面对的问题。
第九年遇上长久热浪。高产鸡吃料减少，薄壳蛋增多，许多母鸡很快停产；同一家系还出现相似的腿病。邻村那些产蛋较少、来源更杂的鸡舍同样受热，却恢复得快得多。陆川想从冠军家系里再挑一批最能下蛋的，发现可选亲缘已经非常接近。兽医费用与停产损失抹去两年高产溢价，让隐藏权衡终于在财务上显形。
兽医和育种员翻查多年记录，指出被挑选的性状会连同相关性状和基因组合一起改变。单一环境里的冠军未必在炎热、不同饲料或疾病压力下仍是冠军；亲本过度集中，也让隐藏缺陷更容易相遇，并减少未来可用的变化。记录把遗传关系同饲料、热、年龄与饲养条件分开；性状须有足够遗传基础才可选择，但实际表现仍属于特定环境。
陆川把冠军家系的订购单推回桌子另一边，取消一份大宗蛋约，把无亲缘鸡引入多个育种群。蛋量只能慢慢恢复。配种记录限制近亲，保存材料与活体家系则保留当前指数尚未重视的选择。选种指数用公开权重组合多项性状，基因组与系谱帮助管理亲缘，却不取代实际健康和福利观察。
新的目标同时记录产蛋、蛋壳、健康、繁殖、行为和耐热，并在不同农场试养。陆川引入不相关家系，保存种群，不再让一只冠军公鸡覆盖整代。进步慢了些，却不再只把损失藏到别的性状和下一次极端天气里。各性状权重在结果出现前公布，免得一次好季节悄悄改写育种目标。进展报告列出每个性状的得失，不再只报鸡舍门牌上的蛋数。
秋季选种时，产蛋最多的母鸡仍站在第一格。陆川越过它，把脚力好、蛋壳稳定、炎夏也持续产蛋的第二只母鸡戴上了亲本脚环。
explanationParagraphs: Selective breeding changes future populations by choosing parents with heritable traits, but selection on one measure can also alter genetically correlated traits, diversity, and inbreeding risk. Performance may change across environments. Multi-trait objectives, representative trials in different conditions, kinship management, welfare assessment, and preservation of genetic resources reduce hidden losses accompanying improvement in one number.
explanationParagraphsZh: 选择育种通过具有可遗传性状的亲本改变后代群体，但选择一个指标也会影响遗传相关性状、遗传多样性和近交风险。表现还可能随环境改变。多性状育种目标、不同环境的代表性试验、亲缘管理、福利评估和种质保存，能减少单项进步伴随的隐蔽损失。

articles.title: The Cut That Preserved the Flavour
articles.summary: When an old pear tree begins to die, its owner plants the seeds expecting the same fruit; years later, every seedling bears something different.
articles.summaryZh: 老梨树将死，园主种下它的种子等着原味回来，几年后结出的梨却一棵一个样。
storyParagraphs: A botanical garden held an old pear tree whose fruit carried a faint honey aroma, a variety inherited from the owner's mother. Waterlogged roots weakened it each year, so the owner collected every seed and planted two rows of seedlings. Children resemble their mother, he thought; the old pear flavour was secure. A buyer offered to propagate the famous pear if the owner could supply identical trees within three years, adding a commercial deadline to the family memory.

Years later, the young trees bore fruit. Some pears were sour, some hard, and some lacked fragrance; none exactly matched the old tree. The gardener explained that seed combines two genetic sources and reshuffles them. Preserving the same fruit could not rely on seed to copy its parent. She cut buds and short shoots from the remaining healthy branches and joined them to several compatible rooted young trees. The seedlings were valuable new variation, but they could not promise genetic identity with the parent.

At the bench, the gardener matched cut surfaces so living cambial regions met, bound the joint against drying, and labelled scion, rootstock, date, and source. Bud break alone did not prove lasting union; each tree was watched through wind, growth, and fruiting. One vigorous first-year graft later failed at an incompatible junction. The cut was made in the appropriate season, protected from drying, and inspected for callus and vascular connection before supports were removed.

She cleaned her knife between plants and labelled every source. Not every combination worked. One union healed poorly and broke in wind; one root kept the tree small, while another tolerated wet soil. The upper shoot retained the old pear variety, but the lower partner influenced vigour, fruiting time, and response to soil disease. Choosing several rootstocks cost uniformity and complicated orchard work, but one flood or disease response would no longer decide the fate of every clone. The failed combinations remained labelled in the nursery, preventing the next worker from repeating them as if silence meant success.

The owner did not keep only one replacement. He chose roots suited to different plots, preserved multiple copies, and continued using cuttings and seed for other plants so the whole garden did not share one genetic background. Diseased plants and tool hygiene were managed to avoid preserving a pathogen together with the variety. The third pear was cut and its flavour recorded only after the tree had carried a full season without union failure. The fruit matched the remembered flavour closely, but the owner kept records because rootstock and site could still influence size, timing, and condition. In the second year after the old tree fell, the first new tree carried three pears. The owner cut and tasted one, then left the other two among the leaves instead of picking them all.
storyParagraphsZh: 百果园有棵老梨树，果肉带一点蜂蜜香，是园主母亲留下的品种。树根受涝后逐年衰弱，园主急忙收下全部种子，种了两排小树。他相信孩子总会像母亲，老梨的味道已经保住。买家答应三年内若能提供同样果树便长期采购，让家族记忆又多了一道商业期限。
几年后，小树陆续结果。有的酸，有的硬，有的香气全无，没有一棵完全像老树。园丁解释，种子由两份遗传来源形成，会重新组合；想保留同一结果，不能只等种子把原树复制出来。她从尚健康的枝上取下芽和短枝，接到几种相容的有根幼树上。实生苗带来有价值的新变异，却不能承诺与母树遗传相同。
操作台上，园丁让切面形成层相接，绑紧接口防干，并标明接穗、砧木、日期与来源。芽萌发并不证明长久愈合，每株还要经历风、长势与结果观察；一株首年旺盛的嫁接树后来仍从不亲和接口断开。切口在合适季节完成并防止干燥，支撑拆除以前还要检查愈伤与维管连接。
她的刀每换一棵树都清洁一次，每个来源也挂上标签。不是所有组合都成功：一株接口愈合不好，风来时折断；另一种根让树长得矮，第三种更能忍受湿土。上面的枝仍保留老梨品种，下面的根却会影响树势、结果时机和对土壤病害的反应。选多种砧木牺牲整齐，也增加管理复杂度，却不再让一次洪水或病害反应决定全部克隆的命运。失败组合仍带标签留在苗圃，免得后来者把沉默误作成功而重复。

园主没有只留一株新树。他选择适合不同地块的根系，保留多份来源，继续用扦插和种子繁育其他植物，以免整个果园只有同一种遗传背景。病株和工具卫生也受到管理，防止保存品种时一并传播病害。第三只梨在接口完整承受一个季节以后才被切开，香味也随之记录。果味接近记忆，园主仍保留记录，因为砧木与地点还会影响大小、时期与状态。老梨树倒下后的第二年，第一棵新树结了三只梨。园主切开一只尝过，把另外两只放回枝叶间，没有急着摘完。
explanationParagraphs: Grafting joins a desired shoot or bud to a compatible rooted plant so healing and vascular continuity form, clonally preserving the scion genotype. The rootstock retains its own genes and influences vigour, adaptation, and aspects of performance. Seed propagation creates genetic recombination, while other propagation methods serve different purposes. Success also depends on compatibility, timing, hygiene, healthy material, traceability, and diversity management.
explanationParagraphsZh: 嫁接把目标枝条或芽与相容的有根植株连接，使愈伤和维管组织连续，从而克隆保留接穗基因型；砧木仍保留自身基因，并影响树势、适应性和部分表现。种子繁殖会产生遗传重组，其他繁殖方法各有用途。成功还依赖亲和性、时机、卫生、健康材料、追踪和多样性管理。

articles.title: The Weather Station Had No Frost
articles.summary: The estate weather station remains above freezing all night, yet grape buds in the hollow are white with frost by morning.
articles.summaryZh: 庄园天气站整夜都在零度以上，清晨低洼处的葡萄芽却覆着一层白霜。
storyParagraphs: The vineyard weather station stood on the estate's high ground and forecast a minimum of two degrees above freezing. The owner therefore did not start frost protection. At dawn, grass beside the station remained green, but three rows of newly budding vines in the hollow were white with frost. Vines of the same variety beside a south-facing wall were unharmed. The damaged buds belonged to a high-value new planting, and the insurer refused payment because the official station never crossed the frost threshold.

The owner blamed an inaccurate station. A horticulturist placed thermometers from the ridge to the hollow and recorded wind, humidity, and leaf temperature. On a clear, still night the ground lost heat and cold air drained downhill like water, collecting below. The stone wall released warmth stored during the day. Less than a hundred paces apart, plants experienced different nights. Smoke tests at dusk showed where cold air pooled behind a hedge, giving the temperature pattern a visible path.

The owner folded the heater quotation into the decorative-wall plans and spent the money mapping the vineyard first. Sensors were shielded, calibrated, and placed at bud height across slope positions; repeated nights distinguished a persistent cold pocket from one faulty reading. Radiation shields prevented direct sun from heating sensors, and reference checks exposed one probe that read consistently high.

Summer measurements revealed another pattern. The wall could overheat, moisture lingered behind hedges, and leaves inside dense canopies stayed wet. Average weather at one point could not replace local conditions around the crop at critical times. A sensor at the wrong height or place might record an irrelevant location very accurately. Maps combined minimum temperature with wind and humidity rather than turning one night into a permanent zone boundary.

The vineyard distributed sensors across terrain and canopy. Later-budding varieties went into the hollow, and an opening in the hedge allowed cold air to drain. Wind protection, shade, and irrigation were used where appropriate, with checks for added humidity or disease. Local measures could moderate risk but could not remove a regional extreme. Opening the hedge reduced frost pooling but increased wind exposure, so the team monitored both outcomes before extending the change. The owner accepted a smaller planting area in the cold pocket, losing projected revenue but avoiding repeated rescue costs.

On a frost night the next year, the hill station read one degree above zero while the hollow reached two below. The owner clipped both records to the same board and ran downhill instead of arguing with the station.
storyParagraphsZh: 葡萄园的天气站立在庄园高处，预报夜间最低两度。园主因此没有启动防霜措施。清晨，站旁草叶仍是绿色，坡底三排刚萌芽的葡萄却全覆着白霜；南墙边的同批葡萄则安然无事。受损嫩芽来自高价新园，保险方又因官方站未越过霜冻阈值而拒绝赔付。
园主责怪天气站失准。园艺师带着几支温度计，从山脊一路放到低洼处，又记录风、湿度和叶面温度。无风晴夜里，地面散热，冷空气像水一样顺坡沉到低处；石墙白天储下的热则保护了近旁枝芽。相隔不到百步，植物经历的夜晚并不相同。黄昏烟流试验显示冷空气在篱后何处积聚，让温度差有了可见路径。
园主把加热器报价单折进装饰墙图纸，先把那笔钱用来绘制葡萄园分布。传感器经遮蔽、校准，并按坡位放在芽高；连续多夜记录用来区分稳定冷穴与一次故障读数。辐射罩避免太阳直接加热传感器，参照核对还找出一支始终偏高的探头。
夏天的测量也显示另一幅图：墙边可能过热，树篱背风处湿气停留更久，密冠内部叶面迟迟不干。一个位置的平均天气无法替代作物周围、在关键时刻发生的局部条件，传感器若放错高度和位置，也只会准确记录不相关的地方。分区图把最低温同风与湿度结合，不让一个夜晚直接变成永久边界。
园里按地形和冠层布置了多个传感器，低洼地改种较晚萌芽品种，并清出阻挡冷空气下泄的篱口。防风、遮阴和灌溉分别用于合适地块，同时检查它们是否增加潮湿或病害。措施只能缓和局部风险，遇到区域性严寒仍需更大的应对。打开篱口减少积冷，却增加风害；团队同时监测两种结果，才决定是否继续扩大。园主缩小冷穴种植面积，牺牲预计收入，避免反复抢救。
第二年霜夜，山顶读数是一度，坡底已到零下二度。园主把两张记录夹在同一块板上，先跑向坡底，而不是去同天气站争辩。
explanationParagraphs: A microclimate is the local pattern of temperature, radiation, humidity, wind, and moisture created by terrain, surfaces, vegetation, soil, and structures, which may differ sharply from regional averages. Relevant scale depends on the organism and process, so sensor position, height, and timing must fit the question. Local design can moderate frost, heat, wind, or moisture risks but may create trade-offs and cannot remove regional extremes.
explanationParagraphsZh: 微气候是地形、表面、植被、土壤和结构在局部形成的温度、辐射、湿度、风与水分格局，相对区域平均可有明显差异。相关尺度取决于作物和过程，传感器位置、高度与时机必须匹配问题。局部设计能缓和霜冻、热、风或湿度风险，但也可能带来权衡，且不能消除区域极端。

articles.title: The Calendar Was Not Late
articles.summary: The orchard receives its hives on the same date every year; when blossom opens early, the bees arrive exactly on time beneath falling petals.
articles.summaryZh: 果园每年都在同一天迎接蜂箱，那年梨花提前开放，蜂车准时到达时，枝头已经落满白瓣。
storyParagraphs: White Creek Orchard followed a calendar left by the owner's grandfather: hives arrived on 12 April, flowers were thinned on 20 April, and late-frost precautions began in early May. For decades the dates rarely failed. Owner He Jia printed them on the shed wall so no one needed to look up and guess the season. Fixed bookings reduced coordination cost and had worked long enough to become invisible infrastructure.

One winter was unusually warm, followed by clear heat at the end of February. Pear branches filled with blossom before March ended, but the beekeeper arrived on the contracted 12 April. The hive cart entered exactly on time as white petals covered the ground. A later frost then damaged the early fruit, and autumn yield was less than half the usual crop. The hive rental and lost crop consumed the reserve intended for irrigation repairs.
He let the old contract expire and paid to build field observations into the next decision.

The delay cost him an early-booking discount. He trained workers to record standard stages rather than impressions such as 'spring feels early.' Dates, temperature accumulation, variety, and observer were kept together. Workers compared first bloom, peak bloom, and fruit set across varieties; a single early flower no longer triggered the whole plan.

He blamed the beekeeper for arriving late; the beekeeper pointed to the date in the contract. A naturalist opened years of records. Pear bloom responded to winter chilling, later warmth, and variety. Wild bees and other insects could follow different cues, while frost did not necessarily move earlier with flowering. The calendar had not been late, but dependent living events had moved apart. Degree-day models were treated as aids and recalibrated with observations, while frost risk remained a separate forecast and contingency.

The orchard began weekly standardized records of bud swelling, first and peak bloom, insect appearance, and frost dates, preserving long comparisons. Hive movement followed buds and short-term forecasts rather than the month alone. Early and late flowering resources remained at the orchard edge, reducing reliance on one delivery. Records improved prediction without removing uncertainty among varieties, sites, and years. Historical records were not discarded; they became a baseline against which shifts and mismatches could be tested. The second hive delivery was split into two windows, costing more transport but reducing dependence on one predicted date.

When the first pear flower opened the following March, He took down the old calendar. He drew a thin line through 12 April and wrote the current date in the first box of the flowering record. The erased date stayed readable.
storyParagraphsZh: 白溪果园沿用祖父留下的日历：四月十二日运来蜂箱，四月二十日疏花，五月初防晚霜。几十年里，这套日期很少出错。园主何嘉把安排印在工棚墙上，谁也不必再抬头猜季节。固定日期降低协调成本，又连续多年有效，久而久之便像无需检查的基础设施。
一个冬天异常温暖，二月末又连续晴热。梨花在三月底便开满枝头，可蜂农仍按合同在四月十二日抵达。蜂车准时驶进果园时，地上已经铺着白瓣。随后一场晚霜又伤了过早萌出的幼果，秋天收成不到往年一半。蜂箱租金和歉收耗掉原本维修灌溉的储备。
何嘉眼看旧供货合同到期，付钱把田间观察写进下一轮决策。
这次拖延让他失去提前预订折扣。他训练工人记录统一阶段，不再写“春天似乎早”。日期、积温、品种与观察者一起保存。工人按品种比较初花、盛花与坐果，不再由一朵早花启动全部安排。
何嘉责怪蜂农来迟，蜂农指着合同上的日期。自然观察员却翻出多年记录：梨树开花受低温积累、后续热量和品种影响，野蜂与昆虫还可能依赖不同线索，霜冻也不会随花期一起前移。日历没有迟到，彼此依赖的生命事件却已经错开。积温模型只作辅助，并用实测校准；霜冻风险仍有独立预报与预案。
果园开始每周记录芽膨大、初花、盛花、昆虫出现和霜日，并使用统一标准，保留长期比较。蜂箱调运改看花芽与短期预报，不再只看月份；园边也保留早晚开花的资源，减少完全依赖一次到车。记录帮助预测，却不能消除品种、地点和年份的不确定。旧日历没有被丢弃，而成为检验变化与错配的基线。蜂箱分两批到场，多付运输费，却减少对一个预测日期的依赖。
第二年三月，第一朵梨花打开。何嘉取下墙上的旧日历，在四月十二日旁画了一条细线，又把当天日期写在花期记录的第一格。被划过的旧日期仍然可辨。
explanationParagraphs: Phenology studies the timing of recurring life events such as flowering, migration, breeding, and leaf fall and their relationship with seasonal and year-to-year environments. Different organisms may respond to chilling, accumulated warmth, day length, moisture, genetics, and other cues, so environmental change can create mismatches. Standardized long-term observations reveal trends, but prediction remains specific to organism, site, and context.
explanationParagraphsZh: 物候学研究开花、迁徙、繁殖、落叶等反复生命事件的时间，以及它们同季节和年际环境的关系。不同生物可能分别响应低温积累、热量、日长、水分和遗传等线索，因此环境变化会造成相互作用错配。标准化长期观察能揭示趋势，但预测必须针对物种、地点和情境。

articles.title: The Forest That Never Grew Smaller in the Ledger
articles.titleZh: 账本里没有变少的森林
articles.summary: A forest cuts no more timber than its measured annual growth; the ledger stays balanced while old trees and seedlings become increasingly scarce.
articles.summaryZh: 林场每年砍掉的木材都不超过测得的新增体积，账本始终平衡，山里却越来越难找到老树和幼苗。
storyParagraphs: Green Fir Forest adopted a rule it considered permanently safe: cut only the volume of timber the mountain grew in a year. Surveyors entered annual increment in a ledger, and the manager never exceeded it. Timber output remained stable, so the city sawmill praised a forest that repaid its own account. The annual number also secured mill contracts, so changing it threatened jobs beyond the forest.

Harvests always favoured the largest, straightest old trees beside roads because they were valuable and cheap to move. Ten years later, total volume in the ledger had barely fallen, but fast-growing young stands contained few old seed trees. A slow-growing shade species became scarce, road soil washed into streams during storms, and the next wind event felled large areas of even-aged young forest together. The mill's steady orders had masked declining optionality: timber volume remained while future seed, species balance, and storm resistance narrowed.

A new forester separated harvest by place, age, and species. Total growth could equal total cutting without returning the removed structure at the same location or time. Mortality, regeneration, wind and fire, timber quality, and access costs altered future supply, while streams, habitat, and local uses never appeared in the sawmill ledger. They built age-class tables, regeneration surveys, and growth-and-yield projections by management unit rather than averaging the mountain.

The manager left the remaining old roadside stands marked but uncut, paid the mill's contract penalty, and negotiated variable deliveries while young areas matured and mill trucks waited outside. A monitoring trigger required proven regeneration and retained seed sources before the next entry; storm losses automatically reopened the plan. Harvest scheduling included road recovery and stream protection, because extracting the nominal volume could still degrade future access and other forest functions.

Under uncertainty, the forest reduced harvest, retained seed sources and old patches, distributed cutting, and protected stream edges. Successful regeneration in each site came before the next entry, and drought or storm results changed the plan through monitoring. Reliable timber remained an objective but no longer stood for the forest's entire future. Scenario ranges replaced one precise forecast, making drought and measurement error visible in the allowable cut. Local users and the mill saw the scenarios before approval, making employment and non-timber effects explicit rather than invisible vetoes.

The next season, the manager reached a large fir already marked with a red circle. It stood on a slope short of seed trees. He wiped the paint away with turpentine and moved the mark to another tree several dozen paces away.
storyParagraphsZh: 青杉林场定下一条自认为永远安全的规则：全山一年长出多少木材，就砍掉多少。测量员每年把新增体积写进账本，场长也从不超过那个数字。木材产量稳定，城里的锯木厂因此称赞这片森林会自己还账。年度数字还绑定锯木厂合同，调整它会影响森林之外的工作。
可采伐总挑路边最大、最直的老树，因为它们最值钱、运出也最便宜。十年后，账本里的总体积仍没明显下降，年轻密林长得很快，却缺少能结大量种子的老树；阴坡一种慢生树越来越少，林道旁的土在暴雨中流进溪流。下一场风暴又集中刮倒了同龄幼林。锯木厂稳定订单掩住选择空间缩小：木材体积尚在，未来种源、树种平衡与抗风能力却在减少。
新任林务员把采伐量分回地点、年龄和树种查看。总生长能抵消总砍伐，并不代表被拿走的结构会在同一地点、同一时间回来。死亡、更新、风火扰动、木材质量和通达成本也会改变未来供给，而溪流、栖息地和当地使用并没有出现在锯木账上。众人按经营小区建立龄级表、更新调查和生长收获预测，不再把整座山平均成一个数字。
场长让剩余路边老林保留砍伐标记，却没有下锯。木厂卡车等在门外，他支付违约金，在幼林成熟前改谈浮动交付。再次进场前必须证明更新成功并保留种源；风灾损失则自动触发重审。采伐计划还纳入林道恢复与溪流保护，因为取出名义木量仍可能损害未来通达和其他森林功能。
林场降低了不确定情况下的采量，保留种源与老龄斑块，分散采伐并保护溪边。每块地先确认更新成功，再决定下一轮；风灾或干旱后，计划随监测调整。稳定木材仍是目标，却不再被当作森林全部的未来。情景范围取代单一精确预测，让干旱与测量误差进入允许采量。地方使用者与锯木厂在批准前查看情景，让就业与非木材影响明示，而非成为暗中否决。
下一季，场长走到一棵已经画上红圈的大杉树前。它正好位于一片缺少种树的坡面。他用松节油擦掉红圈，把标记移到几十步外另一棵树上。
explanationParagraphs: Sustainable yield sets a harvest rate and spatial pattern that can be maintained under stated objectives and uncertainty without undermining the productive stock and regeneration needed for future output. It requires more than comparing total growth with total cutting: age and species structure, mortality, regeneration, location, disturbance, timber quality, and management all matter. Sustained commodity production is only one part of ecological and social sustainability.
explanationParagraphsZh: 可持续采伐量是在明确目标和不确定性下，以不破坏未来产量所需的生产储量和更新能力为条件，确定可长期维持的采伐速率与空间格局。判断不能只比较总生长与总砍伐，还要考虑年龄和树种结构、死亡、再生、地点、扰动、木材质量及管理。商品产量持续也只是生态和社会可持续性的一部分。

articles.title: Two Wastelands That Ignored the Chart
articles.titleZh: 没有照表长成的两块荒地
articles.summary: A forester posts the same grass-shrub-tree recovery chart beside a burned field and a quarry floor; the two sites diverge from the first year.
articles.summaryZh: 林务员把“草、灌木、乔木”的同一张恢复表贴在火烧地和废石场边，两块地却从第一年起就走向不同方向。
storyParagraphs: After a wildfire, a forester took charge of both a burned woodland and an abandoned quarry. At each site he posted the same sign: grass in year one, shrubs in year five, trees in year fifteen, and finally the original forest restored. To accelerate progress, he planted the same 'final' tree species in both places immediately. The sign justified a single restoration contract and let the agency report one simple completion date.

Old roots and buried seed soon emerged from the burned soil. Shrubs grew beside surviving trees and crowded the planted seedlings. The quarry had almost no soil, and its seedlings dried on hot stone; lichens and drought-tolerant grasses arriving on the wind persisted first. Grazing sheep repeatedly ate the quarry edge, keeping it sparse for years. Repeated planting consumed most of the budget while dead seedlings were counted as implementation rather than failure. The quarry's repeated grazing and heat selected which arrivals could persist, so elapsed years alone could not predict convergence.

The officer cancelled the order for another shipment of final-stage trees, surrendered the planting bonus, and fenced small plots for a season of observation. Soil depth, surviving roots, seed arrival, moisture, and repeated disturbance were recorded. Different treatments tested facilitation and competition rather than assuming one ladder. Reference sites were used cautiously: they suggested functions and species pools but did not erase changed soil or climate.

The forester thought both sites had departed from the correct order. An ecologist asked him first to find soil, roots, seed sources, and shade left from before the fire, then to observe which organisms arrived, which helped or hindered later ones, and how new disturbances occurred. The burn retained many legacies; the quarry began near bare substrate. One chance seed or grazing event could redirect either path. Monitoring recorded survival, cover, erosion, and recruitment. When a planted shrub suppressed native seedlings, the treatment was reduced instead of defended by schedule.

Restoration stopped chasing one timetable. Natural regeneration and control of invasive species guided the burn. At the quarry, early work retained fine soil and water, using pioneer plants for shelter before later species arrived. Some open ground remained deliberately because it had developed into a different valuable habitat. Some plots moved toward woodland, others stabilised as open habitat; success was judged against site functions, not resemblance alone.

Years later, a birch absent from the sign appeared in a quarry corner. The forester stood over it with a hoe, then removed only the invasive vine beside it. He did not move the birch into the supposedly correct row.
storyParagraphsZh: 山火过后，林务员同时接管一片烧过的林地和一座废弃石场。他在两处都钉上相同木牌：第一年长草，第五年灌木，第十五年乔木，最后恢复成原来的森林。为了加快进度，他直接在两处种下同一种‘最终’树苗。木牌支撑一份统一恢复合同，也让管理局能报告一个简单完工日期。
烧过的林地很快从土中冒出旧根和种子，几种灌木在幸存树旁长起，外来的树苗反而受挤。石场几乎没有土，树苗在热石上干死，最先留下的是风吹来的地衣和耐旱小草。附近羊群又反复啃食石场边缘，使那里多年停在稀疏草本阶段。反复栽苗耗去大半预算，死苗却仍被算作已经实施，而非失败证据。石场反复放牧与高温筛选能存活的到达者，因此经过多少年并不能独自预测趋同。
林务员取消又一批所谓终态树的订单，放弃栽植奖金，围出小块防牧试验，用一季观察各地约束。土深、存活根系、种子到达、水分与重复干扰逐项记录；不同处理用来检验促进与竞争，而非假设同一阶梯。参照地谨慎使用，只提示功能与物种库，不能抹去已经改变的土壤或气候。
林务员以为两块地都偏离了正确次序。生态学者却让他先找火前留下的土壤、根、种源和阴影，再看谁能到达、谁帮助或阻碍后来者，以及新的干扰怎样发生。烧地保有许多遗产，石场接近从裸地开始；偶然到达的一颗种子和一次放牧都可能改变路径。监测记录存活、覆盖、侵蚀与更新；一种栽植灌木压住本地幼苗后，措施被缩减，而非用时间表辩护。
恢复方案不再追赶同一张时间表。烧地保护自然更新并控制入侵种，石场先留住细土和水，使用能提供遮蔽的先锋植物，再让后续物种逐渐进入。部分开阔地被有意保留，因为那里已经形成不同而有价值的栖息地。一些样地走向林地，另一些稳定为开阔生境；成功按地点功能判断，不只看外貌相似。
多年后，石场角落长出一株木牌上没有写的桦树。林务员拿着锄头站了一会儿，最后只拔掉缠在它旁边的入侵藤，没有把桦树移回所谓正确的一行。
explanationParagraphs: Ecological succession is change in community composition, structure, and processes over time after new habitat forms or disturbance occurs. Legacies such as soil and survivors, dispersal, establishment, facilitation, competition, inhibition, consumption, environment, chance events, and repeated disturbance create multiple possible paths. Succession does not necessarily climb a fixed ladder toward one endpoint; restoration goals should fit site history and desired functions.
explanationParagraphsZh: 生态演替是新生境形成或扰动后，群落组成、结构和过程随时间的变化。土壤与存活生物等遗产、传播、建立、促进、竞争、抑制、取食、环境、偶然事件和反复扰动共同塑造多条可能路径。演替不是必然沿固定阶梯到达唯一终态，恢复目标应根据地点历史和所需功能调整。

articles.title: Thirty Years Without Fire
articles.summary: A forest crew extinguishes every small flame in the mountains; thirty years later, the forest burns its accumulated fuel all at once.
articles.summaryZh: 护林队扑灭了山里每一簇小火，三十年后，整片森林把积下的枯枝一次烧完。
storyParagraphs: As a young ranger, Han Shuo was famous for rapid suppression. His crew extinguished smoke moments after lightning strikes and prohibited the small wet-season burns long practised by local herders. For thirty years, the mountain showed no obvious burn scars, and officials called it a forest that had finally defeated fire. Suppression protected timber revenue and homes in the short term, so each extinguished ignition reinforced the policy.

Unburned shrubs, fallen branches, and young trees accumulated each year. Plants needing open patches declined and the understorey became dense. During an extreme drought, lightning fire entered the crowns under strong wind. Heavy fuel made it burn far beyond the small fires of earlier years. Crews protected the village but could not prevent large areas of old forest being damaged together. Evacuation and lost timber consumed years of savings, while the uniform dense stand carried flame across boundaries once considered safe.

Han left the stronger-suppression pledge unsigned and funded a slower map of vegetation, ownership, cultural sites, smoke exposure, and escape routes. The delay cost him a promotion tied to hectares protected. Treatments were selected by place, never prescribed from the fable for an individual property. Fuel maps separated surface, ladder, and crown fuels, while historical records distinguished frequent low-intensity fire from rare severe events.

The investigation did not produce the simple answer that more burning was always better. Forest types, slopes, and communities had different histories; season, frequency, extent, intensity, and severity changed effects. Some wet forests rarely burned, while other ecosystems had long experienced low-intensity patch fire. Universal suppression had itself changed how the next fire could behave. Prescribed work was paired with home hardening and evacuation planning; no burn was treated as a substitute for emergency capacity.

Han worked with traditional fire practitioners, firefighters, and ecologists to divide the landscape. In suitable places they reduced dense fuel and carried out small prescribed burns only when moisture, wind, staffing, and safety plans allowed. Communities strengthened defensible space and evacuation preparation, and monitoring continued after burns. Other methods served places where fire was unsuitable or unsafe. A contingency crew, weather limits, smoke plan, and stop conditions were agreed before ignition; a cancelled burn counted as correct control, not failure. Smoke and ecological responses were measured after the burn, and unexpected effects changed the next prescription.

On the first prescribed burn, flames stayed below ankle height. Han carried the igniter to the planned boundary, then personally extinguished the final strip. Behind him, the ground formed a patchwork of black and pale rather than one charred sheet.
storyParagraphsZh: 年轻时，护林长韩朔以扑火快闻名。雷击刚冒烟，他便带队压灭；牧民按旧习在湿冷季烧过的小片草地，也被一律禁止。三十年里，山上没有留下明显火痕，政府把这称为一片终于战胜火的森林。扑灭小火短期保护木材收入与住家，因此每次成功都继续强化旧政策。
没有烧过的灌木、落枝和幼树一年年堆积。几种需要开阔地的草木减少，林下变得密不透风。极端干旱的一年，雷火在大风中越过树冠，厚燃料让它烧得远超旧日小火。护林队守住了村庄，却无法阻止大片老林同时受损。疏散与木材损失耗尽多年储备，整齐密林又把火越过原以为安全的边界。
韩朔没有在加强扑救的承诺书上签字，转而出资绘制植被、权属、文化地点、烟暴露与撤离路。这套慢方案让他失去按保护面积评定的晋升。措施按地点选择，不能由寓言替个别土地直接开处方。燃料图区分地表、梯状与冠层燃料，历史记录也分开频繁低强度火与罕见严重火。
火后调查没有得出‘应当多烧’这样简单的答案。不同林型、坡向和社区有不同历史；火的季节、频率、范围与强度会改变结果。某些湿林很少需要火，另一些生态系统长期经历低强度斑块燃烧。过去一律扑灭，也已改变了下一场火会怎样发生。计划用火同房屋防护和撤离准备并行，不能把燃烧当成应急能力的替代。
韩朔同当地传统用火者、消防员和生态学者一起划分区域。在适合地点，他们清理过密燃料，并在湿度、风和人员都符合计划时进行小范围规定燃烧；居民区加强防护和撤离准备，烧后持续监测。不能安全处理或不适合燃烧的地方，采用其他办法。点火前先定后备队、天气界限、烟管理与停止条件；不合条件取消燃烧算正确控制，并非失败。燃后监测烟与生态响应，意外结果会直接修改下一次方案。
第一次规定燃烧那天，火线只到脚踝高。韩朔握着点火器一直走到预定边界，亲手把最后一小段火压灭，身后留下黑白相间而非整面焦黑的地面。
explanationParagraphs: Fire ecology studies two-way relationships among fire regimes, organisms, fuels, climate, soil, landscapes, and human societies. Frequency, season, extent, intensity, severity, and history jointly determine effects, so permanent suppression and indiscriminate burning can both be inappropriate. Cultural or prescribed fire, fuel treatment, adaptation, and emergency response require ecosystem-specific evidence, authority, safety conditions, and monitoring.
explanationParagraphsZh: 火生态学研究火制度与生物、燃料、气候、土壤、景观和人类社会的双向关系。火的频率、季节、范围、强度、严重度与历史共同决定影响，因此永久扑灭和无差别燃烧都可能不合适。文化或规定燃烧、燃料处理、适应和应急响应需依据具体生态系统证据、权责、安全条件与监测。

articles.title: The Largest Number on the Sea Chart
articles.summary: A fishing port treats a model's highest long-run average catch as an annual promise; as fish grow scarcer, new sonar still helps the fleet fill its quota.
articles.summaryZh: 渔港把模型算出的最高长期平均捕量当成每年保证，鱼越来越难找时，新声呐仍替船队完成了配额。
storyParagraphs: Using years of data, a Silver Bay scientist calculated that under a set of ideal assumptions, a fish population near an intermediate size grew fastest and could support a highest long-run average catch. The harbour master wrote that number on the chart and used it directly as the annual quota. Fishers borrowed for new boats because they heard 'long-run average' as a promise payable every year. Banks financed boats against the printed quota, turning a biological estimate into a financial promise.

The first seasons were good. Then two cold springs reduced recruitment and gaps appeared in surveys. Fish concentrated in a few deep bays. New sonar still helped crews find them, so total landings did not decline visibly. The more concentrated the catch became, the more everyone trusted the number on the chart. Catch per trip stayed high because technology concentrated effort where fish remained, masking falling abundance. The apparent stability encouraged another boat purchase, further increasing capacity precisely as recruitment weakened.

Before certainty arrived, the harbour cut effort, bought back some permits, and paid temporary support to crews instead of renewing the debt-financed quota, despite protests from boat owners. Scientists compared survey indices, catch age composition, recruitment, and uncertainty across models; no single dense sonar patch could reset the population estimate. The reference point was not accepted as an operational target without considering economic behaviour and implementation error.

In the third year, boats suddenly travelled much farther to fill their holds. The scientist re-examined age structure, young fish, and fishing efficiency and found that the same landing came from fewer adults. The old number assumed stable productivity, accurate observation, and a particular model. It had not left enough room for consecutive poor years, uncertainty, or technology that increased catchability. Decision tables stated how survey decline changed fishing mortality, creating predictable action before political pressure peaked.

Managers turned the theoretical reference into a buffered harvest rule. As population indicators fell, fishing rates declined; below a warning point, the season closed early. Quotas used several surveys and regular updates, protected spawning stock and age structure, and considered food-web effects. Good years no longer surrendered every increase, and bad years did not wait for an empty dock. The control rule was tested against poor recruitment and observation error, with lower trigger points creating explicit consequences. When sonar next showed a dense group in the deep bay, the captain had already received the closure notice. He switched off the screen and clipped his final unused net permit over the old number on the chart.
storyParagraphsZh: 银湾的科学员根据多年资料算出，在一组理想假设下，鱼群保持在中等规模时增长最快，可长期支持一个最高平均捕量。港长把那个数写到海图上，直接作为每年配额。渔民借钱换船，因为他们以为‘长期平均’就是每年都能兑现的保证。银行按印刷配额贷款，把生物估计变成金融承诺。
头几年收成很好。后来连续两个寒冷春季让幼鱼补充减少，调查数据又有空缺。鱼群开始集中在少数深湾，新声呐仍能帮船队找到它们，所以码头上的总渔获看不出明显下降。捕得越集中，大家越相信海图上的数没有错。技术把捕捞集中到剩余鱼群所在处，使单航次渔获仍高，掩盖总量下降。表面稳定又促成一艘新船采购，补充量变弱时捕捞能力反而继续增加。
完全确定尚未到来，港口顶着船主抗议停止续签负债配额，降低捕捞，回购部分许可，并给船员临时支持。科学员比较调查指数、渔获年龄、补充量及不同模型不确定性；一处声呐密集斑不能重置种群估计。参照点不能不考虑经济行为和执行误差，直接变成操作目标。
第三年，船队忽然要跑很远才能装满。科学员重新检查年龄结构、幼鱼数量和捕捞效率，发现同样的渔获已经来自更少的成鱼。原来的数依赖稳定生产力、准确观察和特定模型，并没有为连续坏年份、不确定性和技术提高可捕性留下足够余地。决策表事先写明调查下降如何改变捕捞死亡率，在政治压力最高前便确定行动。
管理者把理论参照改成带缓冲的控制规则：种群指标下降时，捕捞率随之减少；低于警戒线则提前停捕。配额参考多种调查并定期更新，保护产卵群和年龄结构，也考虑食物网影响。好年份不再把所有新增都取走，坏年份也不再等码头空了才行动。控制规则用低补充与观测误差情景检验，较低触发点都有明确降捕后果。下一次声呐在深湾显示出密集鱼群时，船长已经接到停捕通知。他关闭屏幕，把最后一张未用完的网牌夹在海图那个旧数字上。
explanationParagraphs: Maximum sustainable yield is the largest average catch a population could theoretically support over time under specified environmental conditions and a defined model. It is an uncertain reference, not a guaranteed annual quota. Age structure, recruitment variation, changing productivity, catchability, observation error, and ecological relationships can move reality away from the model, so management usually needs precautionary buffers, monitoring, and harvest rules that respond to stock status.
explanationParagraphsZh: 最大可持续产量是在指定环境和模型下，种群理论上可长期支持的最大平均渔获量。它是具有不确定性的参照，不是每年保证的配额。种群年龄结构、补充波动、生产力变化、可捕性、数据误差和生态关系都会使实际情况偏离模型，因此管理通常需要预防性缓冲、监测和随种群状态变化的控制规则。

articles.title: The Haul Missing from the Market Ledger
articles.titleZh: 没有写进鱼市账本的那一网
articles.summary: A shrimp boat records only the shrimp it sells; juvenile fish, turtles, and small sharks caught in the same net disappear before the boat reaches port.
articles.summaryZh: 虾船的账上只记卖掉的虾，跟网一起上来的幼鱼、海龟和小鲨鱼都在回港前消失了。
storyParagraphs: Silver Sand Harbour named its captain of the year by landed shrimp. Qiu Hai's trawler won three years in a row, with every basket of shrimp carefully recorded. Juvenile fish, turtles, and small sharks arriving in the same net could not be sold, so crews threw them back before port. Because they never entered the market, Qiu did not consider them part of the fishery's catch. The prize attracted credit and crew, so recording discarded catch threatened the business identity built around first place.

In the fourth year, nearshore fish declined while the turtle rescue centre received more injured animals. An observer joined the boat and found that one basket of shrimp often came with several baskets of non-target life. Some animals did not survive pressure or time out of water even when returned. Looking only at shrimp left effects on nursery habitat, food relationships, and other fisheries outside the ledger. Discarded animals were sampled by species, size, condition, and location; absence from the quay was no longer treated as zero impact.

The prize judges reached the quay as the observer stepped aboard. Qiu left the trophy form unsigned and used the peak fishing day for paired, comparable tows. He posted the shrimp catch beside the non-target catch, then watched some large animals escape while small fish remained in the tray. A second vessel worked the old net in the same tide for comparison; the observer called out depth and tow time while Qiu's mate wrote down catch handling on a salt-stiff page.

Qiu feared that changing the net would remove his income. A trial began on one vessel. The net gained an opening for larger animals, while mesh and fishing depth were adjusted to the target shrimp. Times and areas where young fish and turtles gathered were temporarily avoided. The observer recorded survival after release rather than merely counting animals thrown overboard. Compensation helped crews accept lower short-term landings, while rules prevented the trial from simply shifting effort to an unobserved night.

The changes reduced some shrimp catch but also shortened sorting and reduced net damage. Monitoring continued because avoiding one place could transfer pressure elsewhere and devices performed differently by species and sea condition. Total effort, habitat, and target-stock condition entered decisions; no one escape panel carried the whole plan. Crew safety, fuel use, seabed contact, and displacement to other grounds were reviewed beside catch composition. Port awards were changed to include documented non-target outcomes, not just shrimp weight.
During one haul, a turtle pushed through the square opening and swam away. Qiu did not tell the crew to narrow it. Beneath that day's shrimp total, he drew one empty square.
storyParagraphsZh: 银沙港按上岸虾量评选年度船长。邱海的拖网船连续三年第一，账本上每一筐虾都写得清楚。网里一同上来的幼鱼、海龟和小鲨鱼不能卖，船员便在回港前扔回海里；邱海认为它们既没进鱼市，就不算这门生意的收获。年度第一带来贷款与船员，记录弃获会动摇围绕冠军建立的生意身份。
第四年，近岸鱼群明显变少，海龟救护站却接到更多受伤个体。一名观察员随船记录，发现一筐虾往往伴着数筐非目标生物，其中一些离水或受压后即使放回也难以存活。只看目标虾，让捕捞对幼鱼栖息地、食物关系和其他渔业的影响全留在账外。弃获按物种、大小、状态与地点抽样，不再把未上码头等同于零影响。
评奖人到达码头时，观察员正跨上船。邱海没有在奖项表上签字，把旺捕日用来做条件相近的配对拖网。他把虾获与非目标渔获并排贴出，又看着部分大型动物从逃生口出去，幼鱼却仍留在盘里。同一潮次，另一艘船使用旧网作比较；观察员高声报水深和拖网时长，邱海的伙伴把渔获处理写在被盐浸硬的纸上。
邱海担心改网会失去收入。试验先从一条船开始：网口增加能让大型动物逃出的装置，网目和作业深度按目标虾调整；幼鱼和海龟聚集的时段与海区暂时避开。观察员还记录放回后的存活，而不是只数甲板上扔下去多少。补偿帮助船员承受短期少捕，规则也防止试验只把作业转到无人观察的夜里。
改动减少了部分虾获，分拣时间和破损网具却也减少。船队继续监测，因为避开一处可能把压力转移到另一处，设备对不同物种和海况的效果也不一样。总作业强度、栖息地和目标种群状态同样进入决定，而非把所有希望交给一扇逃生口。船员安全、耗油、海床接触及压力转移到其他海区，也同渔获组成一起复核。港口奖项改为同时纳入有记录的非目标结果，不再只称虾重。
一次起网时，一只海龟撞开网口的方框游了出去。邱海没有催人把口封小，只在当天账本的虾数下面添了一只空方框。
explanationParagraphs: Bycatch is the unintended capture, injury, or mortality of non-target or unwanted organisms. Ecosystem-based fisheries management also places target fishing within relationships among habitats, food webs, multiple species, environmental change, and people. Gear selectivity, time-area measures, post-release survival, total effort, monitoring, and incentives must work together, with attention to whether an intervention merely shifts impacts elsewhere.
explanationParagraphsZh: 兼捕是捕捞中意外捕获、伤害或杀死非目标和不需要生物。生态系统渔业还把目标捕捞放进栖息地、食物网、多物种、环境和人的关系中管理。渔具选择性、时空避让、释放后存活、总作业强度、监测与激励要共同考虑，也要防止措施只是把影响转移到别处。

articles.title: A Fishing Ban Sent from the Capital
articles.titleZh: 一张从首都寄来的禁渔令
articles.summary: The capital closes a lake by an old calendar after spawning has shifted; lakeside fishers distrust the order, and patrol boats cannot chase every night net.
articles.summaryZh: 首都按旧日历封湖，鱼产卵的海湾却已换了时节；湖边人不相信命令，巡查船也追不上每一张夜网。
storyParagraphs: Each year North Lake received the same fishing closure from the capital. It followed dates set thirty years earlier without asking about that year's water temperature, fish, or village livelihoods. During a warm spring, fish spawned early in East Bay; by the time the ban began, the most vulnerable period had passed. Fishers considered the rule both late and distant and continued setting nets at night. The uniform rule was easy to print and enforce at checkpoints, giving administrators apparent consistency.

Government added patrols but could not guard the long shore. A lakeside council then invited fishers to participate. In its first form, several large-boat owners took every seat and shifted restrictions toward shallows used by small boats, leaving their own deep-water grounds mostly untouched. Meetings multiplied, catches declined, and small operators and shoreline harvesters stopped attending. Small fishers paid fines while well-connected owners moved effort elsewhere, deepening distrust.

The authority left the failed council's empty chairs in place, delayed the season opening, and rebuilt representation and decision rights around them. It funded travel for remote villages. Terms, voting, recusal, data access, and enforcement roles were written before quotas. Independent facilitation prevented the largest fleet from chairing every dispute. Meeting papers were posted in plain language before votes, and minority objections remained attached to final decisions.

A new charter defined which decisions were shared locally and which remained public responsibilities. Transparent seats represented villages, women processors, small and large boats, and ecological interests. Scientific surveys sat beside local observations, while minutes, conflicts of interest, appeals, and penalties were visible. Participation now included authority, responsibility, and accountability, not merely presence in a room. Catch and effort records were cross-checked with independent surveys and landing inspections; local knowledge informed questions without becoming unquestionable.

Together they monitored spawning bays and juveniles, adjusting closure timing to actual indicators. Community patrols connected with lawful enforcement, and kinship could not cancel a violation. If closure displaced pressure toward a neighbouring lake, coordination moved to the larger scale. Rules received regular review and formal routes for correction. Compliance and ecological indicators were reviewed together; participation was not credited merely because a meeting occurred. A compensation and review clause addressed who bore the immediate cost of closures, keeping conservation burdens visible.

The next year, fish gathered early in East Bay. The council announced a temporary closure that day. A large-boat owner hauled his own net first and spread it to dry on the quay; small-boat crews then lifted theirs as well. The old number remained visible beneath it. The date was public.
storyParagraphsZh: 北湖每年都收到首都寄来的同一张禁渔令。命令按三十年前的日期封湖两个月，却没有问当年水温、鱼群或各村生计。暖春里，鱼已经提前在东湾产卵，禁令真正生效时，最脆弱的时段早已过去。渔民觉得规定既迟又远，夜里照样下网。统一命令易印、易在检查站执行，给管理者一种整齐一致。
官府增加巡查，仍守不住漫长岸线。后来成立湖边议事会，让渔民参与。第一轮席位却全被几家大船主拿走，他们把限制推向小船常去的浅湾，自己的深水网区几乎不受影响。会开了很多，捕量仍下降，小船户和岸边采集者也不再出席。小船户承担罚款，有关系的大船主却把作业移往别处，不信任继续加深。
主管机关把失败议会的空椅留在原位，推迟开季，围着它们重画代表与权力，并承担偏远村交通费。议程、投票、回避、数据访问与执法职责都在定配额前写清；独立主持人避免最大船队掌控每场争议。表决前以清楚语言公开材料，少数异议也随最终决定留档。
新章程明确哪些决定由地方共同作出、哪些仍由公共机构负责，并给不同村、女性加工者、小船、大船和生态代表保留公开席位。科学调查同本地观察放在一起，会议记录、利益冲突、申诉和处罚都可查。参与不再只是坐进房间，还包括权力、责任和问责。渔获与努力量记录同独立调查、上岸检查互证；地方知识帮助提出问题，却不因此不可质疑。
各方共同监测产卵湾和幼鱼，按实际指标调整封闭时间；社区巡护同法定执法衔接，违规者不能只靠亲缘免罚。若一处封闭把压力推向邻湖，还要同更大区域协调。规则定期复核，错误也有正式改正的路径。守规与生态指标一起复核，不能只因开过会议便宣称参与成功。补偿与复核条款写清谁承担封闭的即时成本，让保护负担保持可见。
第二年，东湾鱼群提前聚集。议事会当天宣布临时封湾，一名大船主先把自己的网从水里拖起，放在码头晾干；小船户随后也收了网。旧数字仍从下面透出。日期公开可查。
explanationParagraphs: Fisheries co-management shares clearly defined authority and responsibility for decisions, implementation, monitoring, enforcement, and learning among public agencies, resource users, scientists, and affected groups. It requires lawful rights, inclusive representation, transparent evidence, accountability, appeals, conflict resolution, and coordination across scales. Attendance alone is insufficient; unequal power or capture by a few interests can still produce unfair rules.
explanationParagraphsZh: 渔业共同管理让公共机构、资源使用者及相关科学和受影响群体，共享界定清楚的决策、执行、监测、执法和学习权责。它需要合法权利、包容代表、透明证据、问责、申诉、冲突解决和跨尺度协调。让利益相关者参加会议并不足够；若权力失衡或被少数人俘获，参与也可能产生不公规则。

articles.title: Three Casebooks That Never Met
articles.summary: After a flood, a clinic records fever in villagers, a veterinary office records illness in cattle, and a water office records contaminated wells; the three books remain in separate buildings.
articles.summaryZh: 洪水后，诊所记录发热村民，兽医站记录流产牛只，水务所记录井水异常，三本记录却放在三座楼里。
storyParagraphs: After a valley flood receded, the clinic received a series of fever cases, the veterinary office found illness in several cattle herds, and the water service closed two contaminated wells. Each department worked separately. Physicians asked only about human contact, veterinarians examined barns, and water officers measured turbidity. Cases declined for several weeks, then appeared in another village. Separate reporting protected professional routines, but no one held responsibility for patterns crossing their borders.

A rural physician happened to meet the veterinarian at a pharmacy and learned that patients and sick cattle clustered near the same flooded grazing land. Environmental staff added well locations, standing water, and rodent activity, while the laboratory compared samples from people, animals, and water. Evidence suggested several connected routes rather than three unrelated incidents. The joint investigation tested alternatives and timing; shared location suggested connection but did not prove a single transmission route.

At the budget meeting, the district crossed out the new office building and funded a joint incident structure. Data-sharing agreements limited identifiers, laboratories harmonised sample labels, and teams wrote what evidence would confirm or weaken each pathway. Public messages separated established findings from precaution. One shared timeline linked rainfall, animal movement, water tests, and symptom onset while preserving each source and uncertainty.

The joint team did not let one profession replace another. Physicians cared for patients and privacy; veterinarians handled animal diagnosis and immunization; water and agricultural staff improved wellheads, drainage, livestock areas, and manure handling; ecologists observed wildlife and habitat change. Information was shared only as needed, with responsibilities explicit. Actions were evaluated for unintended effects on livelihoods, animal welfare, water access, and wildlife rather than optimising one sector alone. The team rehearsed escalation before the next flood and named one coordinator who could convene sectors without overruling their expertise.

At the next flood warning, villages protected water sources and moved livestock early, while clinics and veterinary offices used linked alerts for unusual events. A shared map brought early signals together and supported action before risks spread. Cooperation did not assume that every illness had one route, but it stopped fragmenting problems that required work across routes. Community representatives reviewed messages and access measures so prevention would not depend on instructions people could not follow.

After flood season, the three old casebooks entered one archive room. The archivist did not combine them into one volume. She placed the same valley number on each spine. The dry net beside it showed the immediate cost.
The three books kept their separate labels; the same valley number now crossed all three spines.
storyParagraphsZh: 河谷洪水退去后，诊所连续接到发热村民；兽医站发现几处牛群生病；水务所则封了两口受污井。三个部门各自忙碌，医生只问人的接触，兽医只查牛舍，水务员只看浑浊度。病例下降几周后又在另一村出现。分开记录保护各专业流程，却没人负责跨越边界的共同图样。
一名乡医偶然在药店碰见兽医，才发现患者和病牛集中在同一片退水草地附近。环境人员补上井位、积水和鼠类活动，实验室再比较来自人、动物和水中的样本。证据指向几条可能相连的传播路径，而不是三个互不相关的事故。联合调查比较替代解释与时间顺序；共同地点提示联系，却不能证明唯一传播路径。
预算会上，地区划掉新办公楼，把钱拨给联合事件结构。共享协议限制身份信息，实验室统一样本标签，各队写明何种证据支持或削弱每条路径；公开沟通则区分已证实发现与预防行动。共同时间线连接降雨、动物移动、水检与症状出现，同时保留各来源及不确定性。
联合小组没有让一种职业替代另一种。医生负责患者和隐私，兽医处理动物诊断与免疫，水务和农业人员改善井口、防洪排水、饲养区与粪污管理，生态人员监测野生动物和栖息地变化。信息只按需要共享，责任也写清楚。措施还要评估对生计、动物福利、饮水与野生动物的副作用，不能只优化一个部门。下一次洪水前，小组演练升级流程，并指定一名能召集各部门、却不凌驾专业判断的协调者。
下一次洪水预警时，村民提前保护水源并转移牲畜，诊所和兽医站使用相连的异常报告。共同地图让早期信号更快相遇，措施也尽量在风险扩散前发生。跨部门合作没有证明所有疾病都来自同一路径，却让必须跨路径处理的问题不再被切碎。社区代表复核信息与可及措施，避免预防依赖人们无法执行的指令。
洪水季结束后，三本旧记录被送进同一间档案室。管理员没有把它们合成一本，只在书脊贴上同一个河谷编号。旁边晾干的网标着即时成本。
三本记录仍保留各自标签，同一个河谷编号却横过三条书脊。
explanationParagraphs: One Health is a collaborative approach to balancing and improving the health of people, domestic animals, wildlife, plants, and ecosystems. It is useful for cross-boundary issues such as zoonoses, food and water safety, antimicrobial resistance, vectors, and environmental hazards. It requires appropriate evidence sharing and coordinated prevention and response without erasing professional expertise, privacy, authority, or the need for evidence about specific transmission routes.
explanationParagraphsZh: 同一健康以协作方式平衡并改善人类、家养动物、野生动物、植物和生态系统健康，适用于人畜共患病、食品水安全、抗微生物药物耐药、媒介和环境危害等跨界问题。它要求共享适当证据、协调预防和响应，但不抹去专业边界、隐私、权责，也不能在缺乏证据时假定传播路径。

articles.title: The Farm Where Eight in Ten Sheep Were Vaccinated
articles.titleZh: 八成已经打过针的羊场
articles.summary: Eight in ten sheep on a farm are immunized, but every unvaccinated lamb lives in one shed that a newly arrived animal passes through.
articles.summaryZh: 羊场总体已有八成免疫，所有尚未接种的幼羊却住在同一间棚里，一只新来的羊从那里走过。
storyParagraphs: After eight in ten sheep at the hill farm were vaccinated, the owner painted 'safe' at the entrance. Lambs not yet at the appropriate vaccination age, animals with insufficient response, and several whose health required delay all shared one warm shed. He saw the farm-wide proportion, not how those sheep contacted one another. The overall figure earned the farm a certificate, so the clustered gaps remained invisible behind one average.

A sheep bought at the spring fair waited beside the warm shed without quarantine. Days later, infection spread rapidly among the lambs. Immunized adults dispersed across the hillside mostly avoided disease, but they did not form an even wall around the shed. Clustered susceptible animals still offered a continuous route. The outbreak response cost weeks of movement restrictions and required veterinary supervision; the fable does not specify treatment for individual animals.

The spring-sale date was painted on the gate. The owner scrubbed it off, mapped ages, pens, contacts, and timing, and found two highly connected pens with low effective coverage. Vaccine records were checked for product, schedule, handling, and expected response rather than counted as identical marks. The contact map showed that market arrivals connected pens otherwise separated, so timing of introductions mattered alongside coverage.

The veterinarian spread the shed map over the owner's painted eighty-per-cent sign. She circled each sick lamb by onset date, then ran red thread through the pens and the spring-fair gate. The thread never crossed most immunized adults; it passed from the unquarantined arrival into the warm shed and along its shared trough. Beside several dose marks she placed faded tags for uncertain response or elapsed time. The owner rubbed at the word 'safe' until the paint blurred, while movement restrictions kept buyers outside the yard.

Workers divided the warm shed, moved new arrivals behind the quarantine gate, and gave each age group its own line in the calendar. The owner walked the red-thread route with the veterinarian, checking product, schedule, handling, boosters, and which animals could not yet be protected. After one lamb coughed, a keeper shut its small gate and pinned the alert to the matching pen on the map. The total percentage remained in the ledger, but every verified alert changed the map beside it. Spring buyers waited another week, and empty sale ropes hung from the posts.

When the next lambs were not yet vaccinated, the owner did not crowd them into one shed. He closed the quarantine gate and tied the new animal's rope to a separate post outside it. None of the links erased the original book.
storyParagraphsZh: 岭上羊场给八成羊接种后，场主便在门口写下‘已经安全’。尚未到合适接种时间的幼羊、接种后反应不足的个体，以及几只因健康原因暂缓的羊，都集中在暖棚里。他只看全场比例，没有看这些羊彼此怎样接触。总体比例让羊场拿到证书，聚集缺口便藏在一个平均数后面。
春市买来的一只羊未经隔离，先在暖棚旁等候。几天后，传染病从幼羊间迅速传播。山坡上分散饲养、已具免疫的成年羊大多没有发病，却没能像一堵均匀的墙那样保护暖棚；易感个体聚在一起，病原仍找到连续通路。疫情响应导致数周移动限制，并须由兽医监督；本寓言不为个体动物规定治疗。
春售日期已经漆在栏门上。场主把它擦掉，改画年龄、栏舍、接触与时间，结果发现两处高连接栏舍的有效覆盖很低。免疫记录还核对产品、程序、保存与预期反应，不能把每个勾都算成相同保护。接触图显示集市新羊会连接原本分开的栏舍，因此引入时机同覆盖率一样重要。
兽医把栏舍图铺在场主写着“八成”的牌子上，按发病日期圈出每只病羔，再用红线穿过羊栏和春市入口。红线绕开大多数已免疫成年羊，却从未经隔离的新羊伸进暖棚，又沿共用料槽连下去。几处接种勾旁，她放上代表反应不明或时间已久的褪色标签。场主伸手擦门口的“安全”二字，油漆渐渐发花；移动限制仍把买家挡在院外。
工人把暖棚隔开，新羊移到检疫栏后，日历也按年龄另起一行。场主跟兽医沿红线逐栏走，核对产品、程序、保存、加强时间，以及哪些羊暂时还得不到保护。一只幼羊咳嗽后，饲养员立即关上小门，把警示钉到地图对应栏位。总百分比仍留在账本里，但每次核实预警，旁边的图就跟着改变。春市买家又等了一周，售羊木桩上只挂着空绳。
下一批幼羊尚未接种时，场主没有再把它们全赶进一间棚。他关上检疫栏门，把新买羊的绳结系在门外那根独立木桩上。任何连接都没有抹去原始记录。
explanationParagraphs: Herd immunity is indirect protection for some susceptible individuals when enough others have effective immunity across the relevant contact network and time, reducing transmission. Required coverage depends on pathogen transmissibility, immune effectiveness and waning, clustering of susceptibility, importation, behaviour, and population structure. A total percentage does not ensure protection in every subgroup, and simplified thresholds cannot replace disease- and setting-specific veterinary planning.
explanationParagraphsZh: 群体免疫是足够多个体在相关接触网络和时间内具有有效免疫、降低传播后，对部分易感个体产生的间接保护。所需覆盖受病原传播性、免疫效果与衰减、易感聚集、外来输入、行为和种群结构影响。总体比例不能保证每个群体都受保护，简化阈值也不能替代针对疾病和场景的兽医计划。

articles.title: The Stable That Lacked Nothing
articles.summary: A champion mare has the cleanest private stall, abundant feed, and normal examinations, yet walks the same seven steps at its door all day.
articles.summaryZh: 冠军母马住着最干净的单间，饲料足、体检正常，却每天在栏门前重复走同样的七步。
storyParagraphs: Racehorse owner Luo Bin kept his champion mare's private stall spotless. Feed arrived by weight, rain and snow stayed outside, and veterinary examinations found no obvious disease. Yet the mare walked seven steps back and forth along the door all day, wearing a bare track into the floor. When approached, she flattened her ears, bit the halter, and refused to leave. Luo said she lacked nothing and merely had a bad temper. The immaculate stall helped the owner market premium breeding, so absence of wounds became a convenient complete score.

An animal-welfare veterinarian first examined hooves, stomach, and old injuries, then feeding pattern, air, floor, light, and rest. She observed whether the mare could contact companions, forage, move, explore, and avoid frightening situations. Long isolation, concentrated meals, and training pain interacted. The absence of acute disease did not mean the mare's daily experience was good. Observers recorded duration, frequency, triggers, and recovery rather than labelling one gesture as a direct reading of emotion.

Luo scratched the mare's name from one race entry, opened the sale-ready stall, and paused training for a broader assessment. He invited the attending veterinarian and experienced handlers to agree on measurable changes. Immediate pain and health issues were addressed professionally before environmental and behavioural trials were expanded. Baseline observations covered day and night, because a quiet inspection visit could miss repeated behaviour and poor rest.

The stable changed more than one item. Pain received treatment, forage was distributed across time, and the mare gradually gained free movement and safe social contact. Training allowed pauses and choice, and the environment offered things to explore. The team recorded eating, resting, posture, social behaviour, and repetitive movement over time instead of treating one quiet moment as proof. Not every choice was offered safely or all at once; plans were adjusted to species, history, risk, and individual response. Changes were introduced one at a time where possible, then reviewed for injury, conflict, feeding, rest, and voluntary engagement.

Weeks later, the mare still walked seven steps occasionally, but she also grazed beside another horse, slept stretched on her side, nosed through hanging forage, and approached a familiar carer voluntarily. Her coat was dry, her belly was full, and the stall was warm; now the records also held hours of rest, chosen contact, exploration, and movement. Judgement still required evidence; no one pretended to read the animal's mind directly. The worn seven-step strip remained unpainted so later observations could compare change without pretending the old pattern had vanished overnight.
One morning, the carer stood outside with a halter and did not reach to catch her. The mare stopped on her sixth step, smelled the halter, and placed her own head through its loop.
storyParagraphsZh: 赛马主人骆宾把冠军母马住的单间打理得一尘不染。饲料按重量送到，雨雪进不来，兽医检查也找不到明显疾病。可母马每天沿栏门来回走七步，磨秃一条地面；有人靠近时，它会贴耳、咬缰，不肯出门。骆宾说它什么都不缺，只是脾气坏。整洁马厩帮助主人销售高价配种，因此“没有伤口”成了一项方便的完整评分。
动物福利兽医先检查蹄、胃和旧伤，又看饲料方式、空气、地面、光照和休息。她随后观察母马能否同伴接触、觅食、移动、探索和避开害怕的事。长期单独关养、集中喂料和训练疼痛彼此作用，体检没有急病，并不代表它每天的体验良好。观察者记录持续时间、频率、诱因与恢复，不把一个动作直接当作读懂情绪。
骆宾从一张参赛表上划掉母马名字，打开便于展示的单间，暂停训练做更广评估。他请主诊兽医和有经验照料员确定可测变化。疼痛与健康问题先由专业人员处理，再逐步扩大环境与行为试验。基线观察覆盖昼夜，免得一次安静巡查漏掉重复行为与休息不良。
马厩改变的不只是一项。疼痛得到处理，粗饲料分散供应，母马逐步增加自由活动和安全同伴接触；训练允许停顿与选择，环境里也有可探索的变化。团队记录进食、休息、姿势、社交和异常重复行为，随时间看改善，而不是凭一次安静就下结论。并非所有选择都能一次安全提供；方案须按物种、经历、风险与个体反应逐步调整。条件允许时逐项改变，再复核受伤、冲突、进食、休息与自愿参与。
几周后，母马仍偶尔走那七步，却开始同另一匹马并肩吃草，侧身卧下睡觉，用鼻子翻找悬挂的草料，也会主动靠近熟悉的照料员。它的皮毛干燥、腹中有食、栏内温暖；新的记录里又添了休息时数、自主接触、探索和活动。判断仍需证据，不能假装直接读懂它的心。那条七步磨痕没有被涂掉，日后观察可据此比较，也不假装旧行为一夜消失。
一天清晨，照料员拿着笼头站在门外，没有伸手去抓。母马停在第六步，闻了闻笼头，自己把头伸进了带圈。
articles.conceptName: Five Domains model of animal welfare
explanationParagraphs: The Five Domains model of animal welfare integrates evidence from nutrition, physical environment, health, and behavioural interactions to infer an animal's likely overall mental experience. It considers negative and positive states, interactions among domains, individual differences, and change over time. The model organizes observation and improvement but cannot read an animal's mind directly or replace species-, individual-, and context-specific professional judgement with a universal checklist.
